name: folio
description: Open source report layout for Haxe, compatible with combit's List & Label: reads List & Label project files and formulas, answers List & Label's calls so a program written against it can use folio as an alternative, and lays the reports out as PDF.
releasenote: Builds as a 32- or 64-bit Linux shared library exporting the same List & Label functions as the Windows DLL, takes fonts from the folders FOLIO_FONTS lists, and describes folio as an open source alternative compatible with combit's List & Label.
